reviews.text:
Almost got it right. What I love about this app:
1. The different choices of fans.
2. The speed settings of fans.

What I hate about this app:
1. The recording of the three fans I really enjoy are looped recordings and they have a sound or click at the ending. So now when I try to fall asleep all I anticipate is these "unnatural" fan sounds. 
2. The app shuts off through out the night. Soon as it stops I wake up. 

Fix these issues and I'll be able to use this app to sleep quick and stay asleep.
Fantastic. Exactly what I was looking for, thank you! Looking forward to more updates.
